name: Bambustudio
tagline: An open-source, cutting-edge, feature-rich slicing software. It contains project-based workflows, systematically optimized slicing algorithms, and an easy-to-use graphical interface, bringing users an incredibly smooth printing experience.
description: Bambu Studio is an open-source, cutting-edge, feature-rich slicing software. It contains project-based workflows, systematically optimized slicing algorithms, and an easy-to-use graphical interface, bringing users an incredibly smooth printing experience.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/bambustudio:02.08.04@sha256:857e937fe1c3451244cb178952e0e7a00241ab48c32cb1ce9ea6b27e4fd729e5
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      DARK_MODE: ''
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
